messages:
nina (eng-security): heads-up: supply-chain alert from upstream: runc fixes landed that change the KMS signing surface. we need a coordinated base-image rebuild + a KMS keywrap review. also some elevated iam grants were applied to build-service last Thurs during emergency ops, so audit correlation required.

ana (eng-runtime): can we split work: infra handles the build window + artifact push, runtime runs smoke/canary, sec does KMS/audit correlation?

raj (eng-infra): yep. propose nightly window 02:00 UTC, auto-rebuild pipeline that tags images as staging+sha, then cosign with KMS wrapped key. need to know which principal will sign so i can update registry ACLs.

leo (sec): current signer principal is serviceAccount:build-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com — last sprint we temporarily added iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator for ops; i'll audit the delta. prefer to issue a short-lived ephemeral key via KMS EKM wrap for the pipeline instead of reusing long-lived perms.

nina (eng-security): make sure pipeline emits an audit event for: build:start, build:push, image:sign, key:wrap, key:unwrap. structured JSON preferred. example: {"actor":"svc:build-service","event":"image:push","image":"registry.stg/base:v1.2","signer":"kms:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/build/cryptoKeys/wrap"} — can we all parse that?

leo (sec): yes. sec can ingest JSON into the audit index. add field "rbac_changes" when any manual iam changes occur in the maintenance window.

ci-bot: CI: rebuild job queued: id=rbld-17580-stg user=nina. watch: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/rbld-17580-stg

ana (eng-runtime): runtime checklist for the rebuilt base image:
- drop CAP_MKNOD, CAP_SYS_ADMIN from default entrypoint
- set no_new_privs=true in Dockerfile
- disable unprivileged userns remap in containerd config for the image
- include debug sidecar for canary pods for faster corecollection

raj (eng-infra): infra tasks:
- create maintenance calendar + freeze builder pool for 5m at cut
- ensure registry has a revocation flag mechanism (if we must untrust a signed artifact)
- grant sec read to gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-17580-stg/*

leo (sec): for audit backfill, i'll run two queries: one for cloud audit admin logs and one for KMS key access logs. suggested filter:
```
logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"build-service@redwood"
protoPayload.methodName:("google.iam.admin.v1.SetIamPolicy" OR "google.iam.admin.v1.BindRole")
timestamp>="2026-03-01T00:00:00Z" AND timestamp<"2026-03-03T00:00:00Z"
```
then correlate with gs://redwood-build-logs/* and KMS audit entries for keyRing 'build'.

nina (eng-security): if we see any sign operations using the pre-change principal during that window, we have to mark artifacts as untrusted and trigger re-sign. include an incident tag in ticket: incident:sign-replay.

ci-bot: job rbld-17580-stg started: runner=builder-x1 image=debian-14 patched runc

ana (eng-runtime): post-build smoke commands to run in staging:
```
kubectl run runc-canary --rm -i --image=registry.stg/base:patched --restart=Never --overrides='{"spec":{"containers":[{"securityContext":{"allowPrivilegeEscalation":false}}]}}'
kubectl exec -it runc-canary -- cat /proc/self/status
```
also run runtime-fuzzer for 20m against canary pods; enable auto-rollback on kernel oops.

raj (eng-infra): we will cosign using KMS plugin: cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/build/cryptoKeys/wrap --output-signature=... wrap+sign step must be recorded in pipeline audit.

leo (sec): add to playbook: if cosign/KMS shows any sign operation from an unexpected principal -> immediately set registry flag 'revoke_trust' and notify sig-security pager. re-signing plan: run rbld-quick-resign job that consumes artifacts from gs://redwood-build-logs/* and signs with new ephemeral key.

nina (eng-security): owners: raj (infra coord + registry flags), ana (runtime canary + fuzz), leo (KMS + audit correlation), nina (overall sec + incident runbook). please post here when the staging image is pushed (rbld-17580-stg).

ci-bot: job rbld-17580-stg completed: status=SUCCESS duration=12m artifacts at gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-17580-stg/

leo (sec): kicking audit correlation now. running KMS audit query and cloud audit diff. will paste CSV to ticket.

nina (eng-security): thanks. runtime, start canary; infra, toggle registry flag to 'staging-only' until canary stable 15m.

ana (eng-runtime): canary up. added eBPF probes to watch for setuid execve and ptrace. will escalate on >3 crashes in 5m.

raj (eng-infra): registry flag set to staging-only. added quick-revoke endpoint: POST /registry/v1/revoke {"image":"registry.stg/base:patched"} for emergency.

leo (sec): audit results: no unexpected sign events found in the backfill window. KMS keywrap entries show wrap/unwrap only by expected service account during window. attaching CSV. continuing monitoring for anomalous rbac events.

nina (eng-security): perfect. i'll update the runbook with the revoke/re-sign play and the exact queries used. closing this coordination thread; keeping everything linked in the runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/kms-wrap-rebuild-2026. :lock:
